title: The Friday Caller  (La llamada del viernes)

segments.t: Después del desayuno, el vestíbulo vuelve a quedar en calma mientras Hannah pone al día el libro de papel y Graham engrasa la bisagra de la puerta. De pronto suena el teléfono del mostrador. Escuchemos.
Linden Courtyard Inn, good morning! Hannah speaking.
Who is it? Another booking for the weekend?
Wait, hello, sir! You are calling about the dark blue suitcase?
Ask him his name! Write it down!
Yes, sir, we locked your bag safely in our closet. What is your name, please?
What is he saying? Why are you frowning?
Sir? He says, 'Please do not open the white paper package. I will come Friday at noon.'
Give me the phone, let me ask him properly!
Too late! He said 'Thank you' and hung up!
Polite voice? Young or old?
Quiet, polite, maybe thirty-five. He sounded nervous, not angry.
Nervous about a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger every hour.
Analicemos despacio esta llamada misteriosa.
Linden Courtyard Inn, good morning! Hannah speaking.
'Linden Courtyard Inn, ¡buenos días! Les habla Hannah.'
Who is it? Another booking for the weekend?
'¿Quién es? ¿Otra reserva para el fin de semana?'
Wait, hello, sir! You are calling about the dark blue suitcase?
'¡Espere, hola, señor! ¿Llama por la maleta azul oscuro?'
Ask him his name! Write it down!
'¡Pregúntale su nombre! ¡Apúntalo!'
Yes, sir, we locked your bag safely in our closet. What is your name, please?
'Sí, señor, guardamos su maleta bajo llave en nuestro armario. ¿Cuál es su nombre, por favor?'
What is he saying? Why are you frowning?
'¿Qué está diciendo? ¿Por qué frunces el ceño?'
Sir? He says, 'Please do not open the white paper package. I will come Friday at noon.'
'¿Señor? Dice: "Por favor, no abran el paquete de papel blanco. Iré el viernes al mediodía."'
Give me the phone, let me ask him properly!
'¡Dame el teléfono, déjame preguntarle como es debido!'
Too late! He said 'Thank you' and hung up!
'¡Demasiado tarde! ¡Dijo "Gracias" y colgó!'
Polite voice? Young or old?
'¿Voz educada? ¿Joven o mayor?'
Quiet, polite, maybe thirty-five. He sounded nervous, not angry.
'Tranquila, educada, quizá de unos treinta y cinco. Sonaba nervioso, no enfadado.'
Nervous about a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger every hour.
'¿Nervioso por un tren de juguete de madera? Esta historia se pone más rara cada hora.'
Oigamos de nuevo toda la escena seguida.

What is he saying? Why are you frowning?
Sir? He says, 'Please do not open the white paper package. I will come Friday at noon.'
Give me the phone, let me ask him properly!
Too late! He said 'Thank you' and hung up!
Polite voice? Young or old?
Quiet, polite, maybe thirty-five. He sounded nervous, not angry.
Nervous about a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger every hour.
Ahora ya tienen una cita exacta —el viernes al mediodía— y una voz nerviosa al teléfono que se niega a dar su nombre. Hasta la próxima escena.
Bye for now!
